summary: Average effect of feature exposure on next-week user value.
All common causes of exposure and weekly value are observed and adjusted for.
Backdoor adjustment using baseline engagement, activity, segment, and account age.
The data were generated with a true effect of 2.000.
Placebo, random-common-cause, and subset checks behave as expected in this controlled example.
The example is simulated and clean by design; real observational analyses require stronger data validation and domain review.
